senses.gloss: f. (τυραννία) sovereignty, absolute rule, usurpation (corresp. to h. זְרוֹעַ).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:3:11">Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᵈ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:4:2">Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>עיקר ט׳ וכ׳</he> the principal designation of their (the priests’) usurpation lies in the words (<cite ref="Hosea 4:4">Hos. IV, 4</cite>).

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite>; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 52ᵇ; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 23">Lev. R. s. 23</cite>, beg. (ref. to <he>בזרוע</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 77:16">Ps. LXXVII, 16</cite>) <he>בטר׳</he> with imperial power. Y. Maas. Sh. V, end, 56ᵈ <he>אלו שהן באין בט׳ לפני וכ׳</he> those who come before the Lord with power (interch. with <he>בזרוע</he>).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 3a:13">Ab. Zar. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>אין הקב״ה בא בט׳ וכ׳</he> the Lord does not deal despotically with his creatures.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 945:13">Yalk. Deut. 945</cite> <he>היה עולה אצל אביו בט׳</he> (Ruth R. introd. <he>במרוצה</he>) came to his father with arrogance.
